children: Red Rock Resorts entered into an Incremental Joinder to add $500 million of incremental term B loans under its senior secured credit agreement. The new loans are fungible with the company’s existing term B loans, bear interest at Term SOFR plus 2.00% (or base rate plus 1.00%), and mature on the existing term B facility’s maturity date. Proceeds will repay outstanding revolving borrowings, cover related fees and expenses, and support general corporate purposes.
: Senior secured incremental term B loan facility
: Deutsche Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Refinance revolver and fund general corporate purposes
